generate_mrcnn_detections: run Mask R-CNN object detection on an image with optional resizing, deblurring, and grayscale conversion
pred2string: convert Mask R-CNN detection predictions into a semicolon-delimited string of class IDs, scores, and bounding boxes
get_mrcnn_model: build a Mask R-CNN inference model from a config with selectable ResNet backbone and device
get_deblurgan_model: create a DeblurGANv2 model from a config for image deblurring before detection
review_mask_rcnn_utils: review the mask_rcnn_utils module for image preprocessing, detection, and model initialization functions
